items.title: Yala — personal finance app for iPhone
body: This video shows every use of https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly end to end, side by side with the user's Gmail account:
• Source Account Impact: the bank alert email in Gmail (jur211296@gmail.com) and the same email read by Yala, with the same amount, merchant and date.
• End-to-End: Gmail before > OAuth consent > Yala imports > Gmail after (nothing sent, deleted or changed) > access revoked in the app and confirmed in Google Account > Linked apps.
Recorded in one take with the development build "Yala Dev" on the iOS Simulator. The OAuth app's publishing status remains "In production".
(The app UI is in English; the Gmail connection sheet is in Spanish and is translated on screen.)

items.title: The user's Gmail, before connecting Yala
body: • Gmail on the web (Safari on the same device), signed in to jur211296@gmail.com.
• Search: from:notificaciones@notificacionesbcp.com.pe — the bank's (BCP) card-alert sender, the only sender Yala searches.
• All results are in the Inbox. The top conversation holds the latest BCP credit-card alerts.

items.step: STEP 1 · THE EMAIL YALA WILL READ
items.title: BCP card alert, Nov 16, 2026, 4:37 AM
body: • From: notificaciones@notificacionesbcp.com.pe (BCP, the bank).
• To: jur211296@gmail.com — the same Google account that is connected to Yala in step 4.
• Body: "Realizaste un consumo de $ 6.83 con tu Tarjeta de Crédito BCP en Ouraring" ("You made a $6.83 purchase with your BCP Credit Card at Ouraring").

items.title: Amount, merchant and date are only in the body
body: • Total del consumo (amount): $ 6.83
• Empresa (merchant): Ouraring
• Fecha y hora (date): 16 de noviembre de 2026 - 04:37 AM
• The card number is already masked by the bank (************9523).
Keep these values in mind: Yala shows the same ones in step 5.

items.title: Home > Inbox
body: • The Inbox is empty: no draft exists yet.
• The envelope button at the top right is "Connect Gmail".

items.title: "Bank email" sheet, before any Google screen
body: Translation of the sheet:
• "Connect your Gmail and your bank's alerts arrive in the Inbox on their own."
• Yala only searches your bank's alert emails (for now, BCP).
• Each alert becomes a draft: you review it and save it.
• The email is read on this iPhone. It is not sent to any server or to any AI.
• Yala does not read the rest of your email, does not write or delete anything, and does not sell or share your data.
• You can remove the permission at any time, here or in your Google Account.

items.title: "Continuar con Google" (Continue with Google)
body: • iOS asks to use accounts.google.com to sign in > Continue.
• Google's sign-in page opens in English.

items.title: The same account as the Gmail inbox in step 1
body: • "Choose an account to continue to Yala": the user picks jur211296@gmail.com.
• This simulator was already signed in to Google, so no password or 2-step verification is typed in this recording.

items.title: Expected while verification is pending
body: • "Google hasn't verified this app" > Advanced > Go to Yala (unsafe).

items.title: "Sign in to Yala"
body: • Name and profile picture: userinfo.profile.
• Email address: userinfo.email.
• Plus openid. The user taps Continue.

items.title: "Yala wants access to your Google Account"
body: • "Select what Yala can access": "View your email messages and settings" — this is https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly.
• The user ticks the box and taps Continue. No other scope is requested.

items.step: STEP 5 · HOW THE SCOPE IS USED (1/2)
items.title: Search: only the bank's alert emails
body: • Gmail API users.messages.list with q = "(from:notificaciones@notificacionesbcp.com.pe) newer_than:180d", maxResults = 5.
• The query only matches the bank's alert sender. No other email is listed or opened.
• Result: "5 borradores nuevos en la Bandeja" (5 new drafts in the Inbox), account jur211296@gmail.com.

items.step: STEP 5 · HOW THE SCOPE IS USED (2/2)
items.title: Read the body and create a draft
body: • For each match, users.messages.get (format=full). The MESSAGE BODY is parsed on the device: amount, currency, merchant and date.
• The 5 drafts are the 5 latest BCP credit-card alerts in that Gmail conversation: Ouraring (Nov 16), FLORA Y FAUNA, E S PRIMAX EJERCITO, CLOUDFLARE (Nov 15) and APL* EXCHANGERATEHOST (Nov 14).
• Each one is marked "Email" and waits for the user's review.

items.title: The Ouraring draft matches the Gmail message
body: • Yala: Ouraring · $ 6.83 · Today (Nov 16) · account in US dollars.
• Gmail (step 1): Ouraring · $ 6.83 · 16 de noviembre de 2026 - 04:37 AM.
• "Email" expands the alert text the draft was read from: "Realizaste un consumo de $ 6.83 con tu Tarjeta de Crédito BCP en Ouraring".

items.title: Pick a category and save
body: • The user picks a category (Tech & accessories) and taps Save.
• Record saved: 16 Nov 2026 · Credit Card Dollars · Ouraring · $ 6.83.
• Nothing is saved without the user's review. The other 4 drafts stay in the Inbox.

items.title: The source email is unchanged
body: • The same BCP alert is still in the Inbox conversation, with the same content.
• Yala only read it. It did not delete, move, archive or label it.

items.title: Same search, same messages
body: • The page is reloaded: from:notificaciones@notificacionesbcp.com.pe lists the same messages as in step 1.
• Every message still carries the Inbox label.

items.title: in:sent newer_than:1d — No results
body: • No email was sent from this account during the demo.
• Yala has no send or compose permission and never sends email.

items.title: in:trash from:notificaciones@notificacionesbcp.com.pe — No results
body: • None of the bank's alerts is in the Trash.
• gmail.readonly cannot delete or modify messages, and Yala never tries to.

items.step: WHY A NARROWER SCOPE IS NOT ENOUGH
items.title: gmail.readonly is the narrowest scope that can read the alert's body
body: • gmail.metadata — headers and labels only. The amount, merchant and date are in the body (step 1), so the feature cannot work.
• gmail.labels, gmail.send, gmail.compose, gmail.insert — cannot read messages.
• gmail.addons.current.message.readonly — only inside a Gmail add-on, for the message the user has open in Gmail. Yala is a native iOS app that imports alerts without the user opening each email.
• Gmail has no scope limited to one sender. Yala limits itself: the search query only matches bank alert senders, at most 5 recent messages, read-only.
• Yala never sends, modifies or deletes email (step 6).

items.title: Google Account > Linked apps > Yala
body: • myaccount.google.com/permissions, filtered by "Yala": Yala is listed (Access to Any account access: 15).
• Yala's page: Sign in with Google, and "Yala has some access to your Google Account": See your profile info · View your email messages and settings.

items.title: "Quitar el permiso de Gmail" (Remove Gmail permission)
body: • Back in Yala, the sheet shows "Conectado como jur211296@gmail.com" (Connected as …).
• Tapping "Remove Gmail permission" revokes the token with Google (GIDSignIn.disconnect). "Connected as …" disappears.

items.step: STEP 8 · CONFIRMED IN THE GOOGLE ACCOUNT
items.title: Linked apps: Yala is gone
body: • Same page, same filter "Yala": "No results found". Access to Any account access went from 15 to 14.
• Yala no longer has any access to this Gmail account.

items.title: Limited use of Gmail data
body: • Gmail data is read and processed on the user's device only. It is not sent to Yala's servers or to any AI service.
• Not sold, not shared, not used for advertising, not used to train AI models. Privacy policy: https://yala-app.pe/privacy
OAuth clients in project yala-502622:
• "Yala iOS (dev)" and "Yala iOS (prod)": the same iOS app (development and App Store builds). Both show this same consent screen and flow; this recording uses the dev client.
• "Yala Web (MCP)": web sign-in for Yala's AI-assistant connector. It requests only "email profile" and never requests any Gmail scope.
Thank you for reviewing.
